$comment: Advisories the CI audit gate tolerates. Each entry needs a reason and a reviewBy date; an expired entry fails the gate so the exception cannot outlive its review. Remove an entry as soon as a patched release is installable.

advisories.reason: ReDoS via single-branch repeated extglobs. No patched release exists (range <=4.0.7, latest is 4.0.7). picomatch is reached only through dev tooling (vitest, vite, tinyglobby, eslint-config-next); `npm audit --omit=dev` is clean, so nothing deployed loads it, and the globs it parses are authored in this repo.
